name: singlet_velocity_velocity_transition_graph
title: Velocity transition graph and embedding projection
description: Builds a row-stochastic cell-to-cell transition matrix from per-cell RNA velocity and a kNN graph, and projects it onto a UMAP when one is present. The default method, scvelo_cosine, is the published comparator; the other kernels exist to reproduce their tools. Writes obsp/velocity_graph, obsp/transition_matrix and obsm/velocity_umap. Do not read edge direction as time order without external time or lineage evidence.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

vkey.description: Layer with per-cell velocity in gene space, or obsm key holding a velocity embedding.

basis.description: Space in which neighbours and displacements are measured; pca or umap restricts both to that embedding.

method.description: Similarity kernel. The default is the published comparator; the others reproduce their own tools.

n_neighbors.description: Candidate neighbours per cell from obsp/connectivities; the graph is rebuilt when it has fewer.

scvelo.description: Options for scvelo_cosine, applied to both the transition matrix and the projection.

lambda_scale.description: Inverse temperature applied to cosine similarities before row normalisation.

sqrt_transform.description: Square-root transform of expression before similarity; fixed here rather than inherited from metadata.

use_negative_cosines.description: Keep negative similarities as repulsive transitions; false clips them to zero.

autoscale.description: Rescale projected arrows by one global factor for display; probabilities are unchanged.

sigma_corr.description: Correlation temperature: transitions are proportional to exp(correlation / sigma_corr).

similarity.description: Similarity between each velocity vector and neighbour displacement.

softmax_scale.description: Softmax scale; null estimates the inverse median absolute logit from the data.

correct_density.description: Correct the projection for neighbourhood density, as dynamo does by default.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/doublet_score. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: counts and kernel identity. Never raw matrices.

n_zero_velocity_cells.description: Cells with zero velocity; their rows are empty.

mean_stored_neighbours.description: Mean number of stored neighbours per non-empty row.

median_top1_probability.description: Median of the largest transition probability per row.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
